title: AI Coding Workflow
description: Learn to transition from a traditional manual coding loop to an AI-augmented workflow focused on planning, verification, and iterative refinement.
learning_objectives: Contrast the traditional development loop with the AI-assisted loop
Apply a structured approach to planning and prompting for feature implementation
Implement a rigorous review process to verify AI-generated code
Execute an iterative refinement cycle to move from initial draft to production-ready code

sections.heading: The Paradigm Shift: Writer to Editor
sections.content_brief: Explain the fundamental shift in the developer's role from primarily writing syntax to acting as an architect and reviewer. Contrast the 'Think-Code-Test' loop with the 'Plan-Prompt-Verify' loop.

sections.heading: Phase 1: Intentional Planning
sections.content_brief: Discuss the importance of defining requirements and constraints before touching the AI. Show how to translate a feature request into a structured prompt that includes context, goals, and technical constraints.
sections.code_context: A high-quality system prompt/instruction for implementing a specific utility function.

sections.heading: Phase 2: Iterative Implementation
sections.content_brief: Cover the strategy of 'chunking'—breaking large features into small, manageable prompts to avoid AI hallucinations and context window limits. Explain how to use iterative feedback to steer the output.
sections.code_context: A sequence of prompt-response iterations showing a function being built in stages.

sections.heading: Phase 3: The Verification Loop
sections.content_brief: Detail the critical step of reviewing AI code. Focus on checking for logic errors, security vulnerabilities, and adherence to project style guides using tests and linting.
sections.code_context: Writing a unit test specifically designed to catch common AI-generated edge-case failures.

sections.heading: Phase 4: Approval and Integration
sections.content_brief: Explain the final human sign-off process. Discuss how to integrate the verified code into the main codebase, including documentation updates and final commit practices.

admonitions.content: Never merge AI-generated code directly into a main branch without running it through your local test suite and performing a manual line-by-line review.
If the AI is struggling with a complex task, try asking it to 'think step-by-step' or write the pseudocode first before implementing the actual logic.
